suggestions.topic: Sepolia Glamsterdam fork post-mortem and Hoodi go/no-go decision
suggestions.rationale: Sepolia forked on October 6 (two days ago). Post-mortem needed to capture any issues. Hoodi go/no-go decision was scheduled for October 8 (today) with tentative fork date October 27.

suggestions.topic: JUMPDEST attack repricing decision following devnet-8 retest results
suggestions.rationale: ACDT #98 deferred repricing decision pending devnet-8 retest without debug tracing. This test was planned for completion before the mainnet shadow fork (~mid-October). Results should inform whether 200M gas limit requires adjustment.

suggestions.topic: BAL retention alignment with CL serving window
suggestions.rationale: Deferred from ACDT #97 (Sept 21) to be brought to ACDE and discussed async. Three options tabled: keep 33,024 epochs, reduce to ~14,299 per EIP-8061, or reduce to 8,192 per EIP-8383. No evidence this was resolved in subsequent meetings.

suggestions.topic: Hegota devnet status: FOCIL and Frames separate devnets
suggestions.rationale: ACDT #97 decided on separate FOCIL-only and Frames-only devnets before combining. ACDT #99 noted focil-devnet-0 was accidentally taken down with reconstruction issues. Update needed on both tracks and timeline for combined devnet (target: before DevCon).

ACDT #98 reached consensus on making FCR opt-in via compatible CL+EL pairs with a new 'confirmed' tag, but implementation approach still needs investigation. Async thread was supposed to be opened but no evidence it happened.

suggestions.topic: Mainnet shadow fork readiness and timeline
suggestions.rationale: ACDT #98 mentioned mainnet shadow fork in ~1.5-2 weeks (mid-October). With Sepolia fork complete, mainnet shadow fork should be imminent. Client readiness confirmation needed.

suggestions.topic: Glamsterdam EIP status transition to Last Call
suggestions.rationale: ACDT #99 action item for EIP authors to open PRs moving Glamsterdam EIPs to Last Call before the next EIP Editing Office Hour. Brief status check on progress.

suggestions.topic: EIP-8411 (Fast Execution Payload Broadcast) CL team ratings update
suggestions.rationale: ACDT #97 mentioned EIP-8142 (BiB) withdrawal in favor of EIP-8411, with CL teams asked to rate ahead of next ACDC. While this is primarily for consensus calls, brief ACDT status update may be useful for coordination.
